page.layout: One blank page, no printed text. A gold stamped emblem (a crowned eagle in an oval) sits near the centre, with brown stains and marks elsewhere.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The gold oval emblem with a crowned double-headed eagle is a later stamp, not printer's matter, so it is not transcribed. Brown stains, a grey mark at the top right and scattered spots are damage or dirt only.
